fails_if: the duplicate-row refusal stops locating each row with its own file and sheet (for example, prints the repeated row without its sheet), or stops refusing identical SOS Variabelnivå rows
note: PAR's workbook repeats the INVARN8 row of PAR_OV byte for byte. The Variabelnivå sheet's header is row 1, so the variable rows are 2 and 3, and the message names the workbook, sheet and row of each. Both rows share one workbook and sheet: a scope slice holds one source, and each source adapter reads its records from one file (SCB, thin) or one variable sheet (SOS), while LISA already refuses a repeated semantic key. So two identical rows on different files or sheets cannot reach this refusal through a delivered input.

sources.description: PAR_OV delivers INVARN8 in two byte-identical Variabelnivå rows.
